gaps: Every record above stands on a search engine's summary of the Binwise result, not a raw page snippet; Binwise and the house site cannot be read directly here, so all Binwise records are held at medium, never high. Check each against the printed list on shift.

The Q5 summary also named Paul Pillot 'Clos Saint-Jean' (2020 $285, 2021 $345, 2023 $400) and Philippe Colin 'Clos Saint-Jean' 2005 ($155) under a Châteauneuf query. Those are Chassagne-Montrachet (Burgundy) premier cru wines, not the Châteauneuf domaine Clos Saint-Jean; they are left for the Burgundy lens and not recorded here. Whether the Châteauneuf Clos Saint-Jean is on the list is unconfirmed.
No price found for Ferrière 2016, Léoville-Las Cases 2020, Lynch-Bages 2020, Mouton-Rothschild 2004 or Beaucastel 2022.
Cos d'Estournel vintages between 1989 and 2020 and their prices are not known.
No other first growth (Lafite, Latour, Margaux, Haut-Brion) and no Pétrus, Cheval Blanc, Ausone or Yquem surfaced; absence in search is not absence from the list.
No Pomerol or Saint-Émilion bottle beyond Gombaude-Guillot 2011 magnum surfaced; no Saint-Émilion name at all.
No white Bordeaux, Pessac-Léognan or Sauternes surfaced.

Northern Rhône: nothing current found (no Côte-Rôtie, Cornas, Saint-Joseph, Crozes); the only Hermitage, Jaboulet La Chapelle 1999 at $143, comes from an undated 'half-price' mention and is low confidence. A Q16 summary quoted Guigal, Chave and Sorrel prices from other restaurants' Binwise lists; none recorded.
Loire: no Chinon, Savennières, Pouilly-Fumé or Muscadet surfaced. Huet 'Le Mont' Demi-Sec 2023 at $60 may be a half bottle: confirm.
Alsace: only Trimbach magnums surfaced; no Zind-Humbrecht, Weinbach or Gewurztraminer confirmed. The Pierre Sparr crémant is already in the pack.

Provence beyond the Minuty glass pour, Bandol, Languedoc, Roussillon, Jura, Savoie, Cahors and the South West: nothing tied to Brennan's. The Q12 summary named Tempier, Simone, Trévallon, Aupilhac and others from other restaurants' Binwise lists; none recorded.
Moulin d'Issan: the house drinks page prints 2021 at $16.00, Binwise (26 September) printed 2023 at $16. Name the open vintage at lineup.
Fall menu changes after 26 September were not checked by this lens.
